description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1085: a server that resets the connection on the TLS ClientHello gives tls.connect and https.request Node 22.22.0's Error: read ECONNRESET, with ECONNRESET's errno and syscall read, then close true; one that ends it there still gives ECONNRESET's Client network socket disconnected before secure TLS connection was established (slicc-kernel 1.159.4 reports the reset, ai-ecoverse/slicc-kernel#1578). ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1104: one that resets as it accepts, before the ClientHello, gives Linux Node's connect ECONNRESET 127.0.0.1:<port>, with syscall connect, address and port (slicc-kernel 1.164.1, ai-ecoverse/slicc-kernel#1624); macOS Node gives read ECONNRESET, so the host output is Linux's
